blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Back-to-back defending champion Talisay City got off to a blistering start after manhandling Barili, 99-49, in its opening game of the South Group-D campaign in the Governor’s Cup U-18 Basketball Tournament on Saturday, October 3. Talisay City, coached by veteran tactician Ronald Bucao, was simply too much for Barili as five of its players finished in double figures in the 50-point rout. The game took place in the Sec. Cerge Remonde Sports and Cultural Center in Argao, southern Cebu. Carl Vincent Cabriana led Talisay City’s balanced offensive attack with 12 points. Jan Laurence Saz chipped in 11. […]...
